nodes.text: P A R T 4 Documents
nodes.zh: 文档

nodes.text: Typed JSON state committed with the transcript, stored as Chord operations and occasional complete bases.
nodes.zh: 与记录一同提交的类型化 `JSON` 状态，存成 `Chord` 操作以及偶尔出现的完整基线。

nodes.text: 4 . 1 Defining a document
nodes.zh: 4.1 定义文档

nodes.text: A definition is a typed token that fixes a document’s kind, version, owner and fork behaviour, and the stored record remembers every one of those choices.
nodes.zh: 定义是一个带类型的词元，它固定文档的 kind、version、所有者和 fork 行为，而存储下来的记录会记住其中每一项选择。

nodes.text: An agent needs state that is not chat: a todo list, a plan, the user’s settings. If that state were stored separately from the transcript, a crash could leave the two out of step. A document is that state, stored in the same commit as the entries. A commit is an atomic save: everything in it is stored together, or nothing is. After this section you can define one and choose how it behaves when a conversation is forked. A document is one JSON object that changes commit by commit. Storage keeps each change either as a small list of edits or as the whole value (bases and deltas (p. 56)). The Harness keeps its own state in five built-in documents (the built-in documents (p. 60)), and you define yours with the same function, defineDoc().
nodes.zh: 智能体需要聊天之外的状态：一份待办清单、一份计划、用户的设置。如果这类状态与记录（transcript）分开存放，一次崩溃就可能让两者失去同步。文档就是这类状态，它与条目存在同一次提交里。提交是一次原子保存：其中的一切要么一起存下，要么都不存。读完本节你就能定义一个文档，并选定会话被分叉时它的行为。文档是一个 JSON 对象，每次提交改动一点。`Storage` 把每次改动保存为一小串编辑，或者保存整个值（基线与增量（p. 56））。`Harness` 把自己的状态放在五个内置文档里（内置文档（p. 60）），而你用同一个函数 `defineDoc()` 定义你的文档。

nodes.text: a per-conversation todo list README §Your Own State TS
nodes.zh: 每个会话一份待办清单 `README §Your Own State` `TS`

lines: history: "latest", // or "rewindable" to read old values with snapshotAsOf() fork: "initial", // what a fork starts with: "initial", "current", or "asOf"
The import line is omitted. "asOf" is only allowed together with history: "rewindable"; the compiler enforces it.

nodes.text: The definition is a token
nodes.zh: 定义就是一个词元

nodes.text: defineDoc() returns a token: a plain object that carries the definition and the value type. It checks only that version is a positive integer src/documents.ts. Nothing is registered. Every read and write passes the token, as in tx.doc(Todos, root.id), and the token supplies the type, the initial value and the migration for that one call spec §3.3. Define each token once in a module and import it everywhere. Two different definitions of the same kind are unsupported, and nothing detects them spec §12.
nodes.zh: `defineDoc()` 返回一个词元：一个普通对象，携带定义和值的类型。它只检查 `version` 是否为正整数 `src/documents.ts`。没有任何东西被注册。每一次读写都把这个词元传进去，如 `tx.doc(Todos, root.id)`，词元为那一次调用提供类型、初始值和迁移 `spec §3.3`。每个词元在一个模块里定义一次，然后到处 import。同一个 kind 的两份不同定义不受支持，也没有任何东西会发现它们 `spec §12`。

nodes.title:
THE SEVEN LEGAL SEMANTICS
T R E E
nodes.caption: Scope fixes owner and lifetime; only conversation documents choose history and fork. The union DocumentSemantics of src/types.ts; fork results from spec §3.7. The right column names the built-in documents that use a combination.
nodes.zh_caption: 作用域决定所有者与存续期；只有 conversation 文档才选择 history 和 fork。`src/types.ts` 中的联合类型 `DocumentSemantics`；fork 来自 `spec §3.7`。右列列出使用该组合的内置文档。

nodes.text: kind string The stored name. It is part of the public protocol and cannot be renamed. version positive integer Version of the value’s shape; stored with every change. scope "session" · "conversation" · "task" Who owns it and how long it lives. history "latest" · "rewindable" Conversation only. Whether old values stay readable. fork "current" · "initial" · "asOf" Conversation only. What a fork’s copy starts with.
nodes.zh: `kind` string 存储时使用的名字。它是公开协议的一部分，不能改名。 `version` 正整数 值的形状版本；随每次改动一起存储。 `scope` `"session"` · `"conversation"` · `"task"` 谁拥有它、它存续多久。 `history` `"latest"` · `"rewindable"` 仅 conversation。旧值是否仍可读。 `fork` `"current"` · `"initial"` · `"asOf"` 仅 conversation。分叉副本从什么开始。

lines: initial() () => T The value of a new document; must be a JSON object.

migrate? (value, fromVersion) => T Upgrades an older stored value when it is read (4.3 (p. 56)). checkpointWhen? (value, ops, info) => boolean When to store the whole value instead of the edits (4.3 (p. 56)). The definition fields, from src/types.ts (CommonDocDefinition, DocumentSemantics).

nodes.text: Scope, history and fork
nodes.zh: 作用域、`history` 与 `fork`

nodes.text: Scope decides the owner and the lifetime. A session document is shared by every conversation and lives until you retire it. A conversation document belongs to one conversation. A task document belongs to one task and is retired automatically when the task ends spec §3.1. Only conversation documents choose a history and a fork policy, which gives seven legal combinations.
nodes.zh: 作用域决定所有者与存续期。session 文档由每个 conversation 共享，一直活到你让它退役为止。conversation 文档只属于一个 conversation。task 文档只属于一个任务，并在任务结束时自动退役 `spec §3.1`。只有 conversation 文档才选择 history 策略和 fork 策略，因此共有七种合法组合。

nodes.text: Scope fixes owner and lifetime; only conversation documents choose history and fork. The union DocumentSemantics of src/types.ts; fork results from spec §3.7. The right column names the built-in documents that use a combination.
nodes.zh: 作用域决定所有者与存续期；只有 conversation 文档才选择 history 和 fork。`src/types.ts` 中的联合类型 `DocumentSemantics`；fork 来自 `spec §3.7`。右列列出使用该组合的内置文档。

nodes.text: history: "latest" keeps only the current value. "rewindable" keeps every stored change, so snapshotAsOf(token, conversationId, entryId) can return the value as it was when any entry was written. The cost is storage: old changes are never deleted (4.3 (p. 56)). fork decides what a forked conversation starts with (forks (p. 43)). "current" copies the parent’s value now. "asOf" copies the value at the fork entry, which only a rewindable document still has. "initial" copies nothing; the fork’s first tx.doc() creates a fresh one. In run 02, a notes document reads after goodbye in the parent, while a fork taken at an earlier entry starts with after hello.
nodes.zh: `history: "latest"` 只保留当前值。`"rewindable"` 保留每一次存储的改动，于是 `snapshotAsOf(token, conversationId, entryId)` 能返回任意条目写入时的那个值。代价是存储：旧改动永不删除（4.3（p. 56））。`fork` 决定被分叉的 conversation 从什么开始（分叉（p. 43））。`"current"` 复制父级当前的值。`"asOf"` 复制分叉条目处的值，而只有可回溯的文档还留着它。`"initial"` 什么都不复制；分叉的第一次 `tx.doc()` 会创建一个全新的。在 run 02 中，父级里的 notes 文档读到的是 after goodbye，而取自更早条目的分叉则从 after hello 开始。

nodes.text: Families
nodes.zh: 文档族

nodes.text: A family is one definition for many documents under one owner, told apart by a string key. Think “one review document per file”. defineDocFamily() takes the same fields plus family: true, and its initializer receives a seed:
nodes.zh: 一个族是同一个定义管住同一个所有者下的许多文档，靠一个字符串 key 区分开来。想象「每个文件一份评审文档」。`defineDocFamily()` 接受相同的字段，外加 `family: true`，它的初始化函数会收到一个 seed：

nodes.text: one review document per file docs/pico-v5-chord-usage.md §2 TS
nodes.zh: 每个文件一份评审文档 `docs/pico-v5-chord-usage.md §2` `TS`

lines: history: "latest", fork: "current", initial: seed => ({ path: seed.path, patch: seed.patch, comments: [] }),

nodes.text: The key is part of the address; the seed is not. The seed is used once, when the member is first created, and ignored after that spec §12. In the capture, a second tx.doc() on key src/a.ts passed the seed {"path":"IGNORED"}, and the member kept "path":"src/a.ts". To change a member, edit it.
nodes.zh: key 是地址的一部分，seed 不是。seed 只在成员首次创建时用一次，之后被忽略 `spec §12`。在这次捕获中，对 key `src/a.ts` 的第二次 `tx.doc()` 传入了 seed `{"path":"IGNORED"}`，成员仍保持 `"path":"src/a.ts"`。要修改成员，请编辑它。

nodes.text: The choices are stored
nodes.zh: 这些选择会被存下来

nodes.text: Each stored document records its kind, scope, history and fork policy, so existing data still makes sense when the code that defined it is missing spec §3.2. Every access checks the token against that record. If you change fork from "initial" to "current" in your code, existing documents do not change. They become unreadable through the new token, which throws Document 4 (app.todos) does not match the supplied definition semantics src/documents.ts.
nodes.zh: 每个存储的文档都记着自己的 kind、scope、history 和 fork 策略，因此定义它的代码不在时，已有数据依然说得通 `spec §3.2`。每次访问都会拿词元与那条记录比对。如果你在代码里把 fork 从 `"initial"` 改成 `"current"`，已有文档不会改变。它们会变得无法通过新词元读取，并抛出 `Document 4 (app.todos) does not match the supplied definition semantics` `src/documents.ts`。

nodes.text: State that describes the transcript, like a plan: rewindable + asOf, so a fork from an old entry sees the matching plan. Example 27’s app.plan and the built-in pi.agent do this. State that belongs to the user, like a draft: current, so a fork takes it as it is now docs/pico-v5-chord-usage.md §2. State that belongs to one branch, like a sandbox or spend: initial. A copied spend counter would count twice, so “a fork starts at zero” spec §8.6. Treat kind, scope, history and fork as permanent. Only the value’s shape can evolve, through version and migrate().
nodes.zh: 描述记录（transcript）的状态，比如计划：`rewindable` + `asOf`，这样从旧条目分叉出来的副本看到的正是那份计划。示例 27 的 `app.plan` 和内置的 `pi.agent` 就是这样。属于用户的状态，比如草稿：`current`，这样分叉会按它现在的样子复制 `docs/pico-v5-chord-usage.md §2`。只属于某个分支的状态，比如沙箱或开销：`initial`。复制一份开销计数器会重复计数，所以要「分叉从零开始」 `spec §8.6`。把 kind、scope、history 和 fork 当作永久不变。只有值的形状可以演进，靠 version 和 `migrate()`。

nodes.title:
THE FIRST TX.DOC() OF A NEW DOCUMENT
S E Q U E N C E
nodes.caption: Creation is a write: the first tx.doc() of a missing document stores its whole value in that commit. From src/session/transaction.ts; ID 4, seq 2 and the value are from research/capture/extra-p4/documents.txt.
nodes.zh_caption: 创建是一次写入：对不存在文档的第一次 `tx.doc()` 会在那次提交里存下它的整个值。来自 `src/session/transaction.ts`；ID 4、seq 2 和该值取自 `research/capture/extra-p4/documents.txt`。

nodes.text: 4 . 2 Access, creation and lifetimes
nodes.zh: 4.2 访问、创建与存续期

nodes.text: Only tx.doc() creates a document; every read returns undefined for one that does not exist, and scope decides what ends a document’s life.
nodes.zh: 只有 `tx.doc()` 会创建文档；任何读取对不存在的文档都返回 `undefined`，而作用域决定文档的存续期何时结束。

nodes.text: You never “create” a document explicitly. The first time a commit asks for it, it exists. Reads are different: they never create anything. After this section you can create, read and retire documents, and say when each one exists.
nodes.zh: 你从不显式「创建」文档。某次提交第一次索要它时，它就存在了。读取不一样：读取从不创建任何东西。读完本节你就能创建、读取和退役文档，并说清每个文档在何时存在。

nodes.text: tx.doc() is get-or-create
nodes.zh: `tx.doc()` 是 get-or-create

nodes.text: Inside a commit, tx.doc() returns a draft: an editable view of the document for this commit only. If the document does not exist yet, the same call creates it. The arguments follow the token’s scope:
nodes.zh: 在一次提交内部，`tx.doc()` 返回一个草稿：仅对本次提交有效的文档可编辑视图。如果文档还不存在，同一个调用会把它创建出来。参数取决于词元的 scope：

nodes.text: session tx.doc(Doc) tx.doc(Doc, key, seed) conversation tx.doc(Doc, conversationId) tx.doc(Doc, conversationId, key, seed) task tx.doc(Doc, taskId) tx.doc(Doc, taskId, key, seed) The Tx.doc overloads in src/types.ts. Reads take the same owner and key, without the seed, plus a Context.
nodes.zh: session `tx.doc(Doc)` `tx.doc(Doc, key, seed)`；conversation `tx.doc(Doc, conversationId)` `tx.doc(Doc, conversationId, key, seed)`；task `tx.doc(Doc, taskId)` `tx.doc(Doc, taskId, key, seed)`。以上是 `src/types.ts` 中的 `Tx.doc` 重载。读取传入同样的所有者与 key，不带 seed，外加一个 `Context`。

lines: Creation is a write: the first tx.doc() of a missing document stores its whole value in that commit. From src/session/transaction.ts; ID 4, seq 2 and the value are from research/capture/extra-p4/documents.txt.

nodes.text: The figure follows one creation. The Session finds no current document (steps 2–3), so it runs initial(), asks storage for a fresh ID, and hands your code a draft (steps 4–7). Asking again in the same commit returns the same draft spec §3.3. Your edits go into the draft (step 8). When your callback returns, the draft is closed, and the commit stores the whole final value, {"items": ["write docs"]}, not the empty initial one (steps 9–10). Other readers see it only after the commit succeeds (the commit (p. 29)).
nodes.zh: 这幅图跟完一次创建。`Session` 找不到当前文档（步骤 2–3），于是运行 `initial()`，向存储要一个新 ID，并把一个草稿交给你的代码（步骤 4–7）。在同一次提交里再要一次会拿到同一个草稿 `spec §3.3`。你的编辑进入草稿（步骤 8）。回调返回时草稿关闭，提交存下整个最终值 `{"items": ["write docs"]}`，而不是那个空的初始值（步骤 9–10）。其他读者要等提交成功后才看得到（提交（p. 29））。

nodes.title:
THREE SCOPES OVER ONE STORAGE
T I M E L I N E
nodes.caption: An incarnation lives from its creating commit up to its retiring commit; scope decides what retires it. One SQLite file: a plain Session wrote seq 1–14, then the file was reopened as a Harness for seq 15–19. research/capture/extra-p4/documents.txt and document-publications.txt.
nodes.zh_caption: 一个化身从创建它的那次提交活到让它退役的那次提交；由作用域决定是什么让它退役。同一个 `SQLite` 文件：一个普通 `Session` 写了 seq 1–14，随后这个文件以 `Harness` 的身份重新打开，写了 seq 15–19。`research/capture/extra-p4/documents.txt` 与 `document-publications.txt`。

nodes.text: tx.doc() on a missing document is a write, even if your code only reads the draft. Use snapshot() to look without creating. A draft kept after its commit is dead: assigning to it “throws: the draft was revoked” spec §3.4.
nodes.zh: 对不存在的文档调用 `tx.doc()` 就是一次写入，即使你的代码只是读那个草稿。想只看而不创建，就用 `snapshot()`。提交之后仍留着的草稿已经死了：往它赋值会「抛出：草稿已被撤销」 `spec §3.4`。

nodes.text: Reads never create
nodes.zh: 读取从不创建

nodes.text: “Snapshot, state, and watch lookup return undefined” for a document that does not exist spec §12. Treat undefined as the default value. In example 11, a prompt section shows nothing while the todo list is missing, and the tool’s tx.doc() creates the list on its first write ex 11.
nodes.zh: 对不存在的文档，「快照、状态和观察查询都返回 `undefined`」 `spec §12`。把 `undefined` 当作默认值。在示例 11 中，待办清单缺失时某个提示词小节什么都不显示，而工具的 `tx.doc()` 在第一次写入时创建这份清单 `ex 11`。

nodes.text: snapshot() the current value snapshotAsOf() the value when an entry was written; rewindable documents only documentState() a read-only live state (8.1 (p. 125)) watchDoc() a stream of committed changes (8.2 (p. 129)) The read methods. snapshot() and snapshotAsOf() are available on the Session, the Harness, tasks, tools and hooks (src/types.ts, src/harness/types.ts).
nodes.zh: `snapshot()` 当前值；`snapshotAsOf()` 某个条目写入时的值，仅可回溯的文档可用；`documentState()` 只读的实时状态（8.1（p. 125））；`watchDoc()` 已提交改动的流（8.2（p. 129））。以上是读取方法。`snapshot()` 和 `snapshotAsOf()` 在 `Session`、`Harness`、任务、工具和钩子上都可用（`src/types.ts`、`src/harness/types.ts`）。

nodes.text: A snapshot is shared, not copied, and it is not frozen. If your code changes it, later readers see the change spec §3.4. Copy it before you modify it.
nodes.zh: 快照是共享的，不是副本，而且它不是冻结的。如果你的代码改了它，后来的读者会看到这个改动 `spec §3.4`。修改之前先复制一份。

nodes.text: What ends a document
nodes.zh: 什么会终结一个文档

nodes.text: Each create-to-retire life of a document is an incarnation, with its own ID. Retiring a document and creating it again gives a new ID; IDs are never reused spec §3.2. The capture retired app.draft (ID 5) at commit 12 and created it again (ID 18) at commit 13. Watchers see a retirement as the value null.
nodes.zh: 一个文档从创建到退役的每一次存续期就是一个化身，有自己的 ID。退役一个文档再重新创建，会得到一个新 ID；ID 从不复用 `spec §3.2`。这次捕获在提交 12 退役了 `app.draft`（ID 5），并在提交 13 重新创建它（ID 18）。观察者看到的退役形态是值 `null`。

lines: An incarnation lives from its creating commit up to its retiring commit; scope decides what retires it. One SQLite file: a plain Session wrote seq 1–14, then the file was reopened as a Harness for seq 15–19. research/capture/extra-p4/documents.txt and document-publications.txt.

nodes.text: Session and conversation — end only when your code calls retireDoc(). Nothing in the Harness does. The Session document app.settings survived a close and reopen with {"theme":"dark"}. Task — ends in the commit that finishes its task spec §3.3. Task 25’s last commit wrote done = 2 and finished the task, so that last edit was never readable. Afterwards snapshot() returns undefined and tx.doc() throws Task 25 is terminal.
nodes.zh: session 与 conversation —— 只有当你的代码调用 `retireDoc()` 时才结束。`Harness` 里没有任何东西会这么做。session 文档 `app.settings` 在关闭并重新打开后仍在，带着 `{"theme":"dark"}`。 task —— 在完成它那次任务的提交里结束 `spec §3.3`。任务 25 的最后一次提交写入 `done = 2` 并结束了任务，因此那最后一次编辑从未被读到。此后 `snapshot()` 返回 `undefined`，`tx.doc()` 抛出 `Task 25 is terminal`。

nodes.text: Documents every conversation gets
nodes.zh: 每个 conversation 都会得到的文档

nodes.text: A Harness creates its five built-in documents in every commit that creates or forks a conversation, through a creation hook src/harness/harness.ts. You can add your own with HarnessOptions.conversationCreated(tx, conversation), which runs right after the built-ins in the same commit. Use it for documents every conversation must have. Use the init option of createConversation() or fork() for data of one call. If either throws, the whole creation fails. A plain Session has no hook and no built-in documents.
nodes.zh: `Harness` 在每一次创建或分叉 conversation 的提交中，通过一个创建钩子创建它的五个内置文档 `src/harness/harness.ts`。你可以用 `HarnessOptions.conversationCreated(tx, conversation)` 添加自己的文档，它在同一提交中紧随内置文档之后运行。用它放每个 conversation 都必须有的文档。单次调用的数据则用 `createConversation()` 或 `fork()` 的 `init` 选项。两者中任何一个抛出，整次创建都会失败。普通 `Session` 没有钩子，也没有内置文档。

nodes.text: Use snapshot() to look, tx.doc() to change. Handle undefined from every read; it means “not created yet” or “retired”. Anything that must outlive a task goes into its result, an entry or a longer-lived document, in the task’s final commit spec §12. Kinds starting with pi. belong to the Harness. Nothing enforces it, but reusing one collides with Harness behaviour spec §12.
nodes.zh: 查看用 `snapshot()`，修改用 `tx.doc()`。每次读取返回的 `undefined` 都要处理；它意味着「尚未创建」或「已退役」。任何必须比任务活得更久的东西，都放进它的结果、一个条目或一份存续期更长的文档，在任务的最后一次提交中完成 `spec §12`。以 `pi.` 开头的 kind 属于 `Harness`。没有任何机制强制这一点，但复用其中一个会与 `Harness` 的行为冲突 `spec §12`。

nodes.text: 4 . 3 Bases, deltas and migrations
nodes.zh: 4.3 基线、增量与迁移

nodes.text: Storage keeps a document as occasional bases, whole copies of the value, plus the small edits between them; your definition decides when to write a base.
nodes.zh: `Storage` 把一个文档保存为偶尔出现的基线，也就是值的完整副本，加上它们之间的少量编辑；何时写基线由你的定义决定。

nodes.text: Saving the whole document on every change wastes space. Saving only the edits makes reads slower and slower, because each read replays every edit. Pi Durable stores mostly edits and, now and then, a whole copy called a base. After this section you can read a document’s rows in a storage dump, choose when bases are written, and change a document’s shape safely.
nodes.zh: 每次改动都保存整个文档会浪费空间。只保存编辑会让读取越来越慢，因为每次读取都要重放所有编辑。Pi Durable 主要保存编辑，偶尔保存一份称为基线的完整副本。读完本节你就能在存储转储中读出一个文档的行、决定何时写基线，并安全地改变文档的形状。

nodes.text: Two kinds of record
nodes.zh: 两种记录

nodes.text: Every stored change is one of two things src/types.ts (DocumentContent): Base — the whole value. Written when the document is created, when its version changes, and when your checkpointWhen() returns true. Delta — the list of edits this commit made, as Chord operations. Written for every other change. Chord generates them from ordinary draft edits; you never write them by hand. A commit that changes nothing writes nothing. Both kinds record the definition version they were written under. The capture ran five commits against two documents with the same rule, info.deltasSinceBase >= 2. app.todos (ID 4) is rewindable; app.draft (ID 5) is latest.
nodes.zh: 每一次存储的改动都是两者之一 `src/types.ts`（`DocumentContent`）：Base —— 整个值。在文档创建时、version 变化时，以及你的 `checkpointWhen()` 返回 true 时写入。 Delta —— 本次提交做出的编辑列表，表示为 `Chord` 操作。其余每一次改动都写成它。`Chord` 从普通的草稿编辑生成这些操作；你从不手写。什么都没改的提交就什么都不写。两种记录都会记下写入时所依据的定义 version。这次捕获用同一条规则对两个文档跑了五次提交，规则是 `info.deltasSinceBase >= 2`。`app.todos`（ID 4）是 `rewindable` 的；`app.draft`（ID 5）是 `latest` 的。

nodes.text: A read finds the newest base and applies every delta after it, in order. ID 5 has no rows before seq 5, because a base on a latest document lets storage delete everything older.

nodes.zh: 一次读取从最新的基线开始，重放它之后的增量；只有可回溯的文档保留更早的记录。行取自 `research/capture/extra-p4/documents.txt`。Seq 7 是一次分叉，对 ID 4 什么都没写；seq 8 和 9 来自下面的迁移。

nodes.text: The checkpoint predicate
nodes.zh: 检查点谓词

nodes.text: checkpointWhen(value, ops, info) is asked once for each ordinary change. If it returns true, that change is stored as a base. info.deltasSinceBase is the number of deltas since the last base, not counting this change; the Session tracks it, so the check costs no storage read. In the capture the rule saw 0, then 1, then 2, so seq 5 became a base. If the predicate throws, the whole commit fails.
nodes.zh: 每次普通改动都会问一次 `checkpointWhen(value, ops, info)`。如果它返回 true，那次改动就存为基线。`info.deltasSinceBase` 是自上一个基线以来的增量数量，不计本次改动；`Session` 会跟踪它，因此这次检查不需要读存储。在这次捕获中，这条规则先后看到 0、1、2，于是 seq 5 成了基线。如果谓词抛出，整次提交失败。

nodes.text: Two styles work well. A count, such as info.deltasSinceBase >= 31, caps how many deltas a read replays. A state test, as in pi.live, takes a base whenever the document is back to a small resting value. The choice affects storage only: watchers and views receive the same edits either way (8.1 (p. 125)).
nodes.zh: 有两种写法都很好用。一个计数，例如 `info.deltasSinceBase >= 31`，给一次读取要重放的增量数封顶。一个状态判断，像 `pi.live` 那样，只要文档回到一个小的静止值就取一个基线。这个选择只影响存储：观察者和视图在两种情况下收到的编辑都相同（8.1（p. 125））。

nodes.text: Without checkpointWhen, a document stores one base at creation and deltas forever. Reads get slower and storage “can grow without bound while the document is live” spec §12. Storage never takes a base on its own spec §3.5.
nodes.zh: 没有 `checkpointWhen`，一个文档在创建时存一个基线，之后永远只存增量。读取会越来越慢，存储「在文档存活期间可以无界增长」 `spec §12`。`Storage` 从不自己取基线 `spec §3.5`。

nodes.text: What a base lets storage delete
nodes.zh: 一个基线让存储可以删除什么

nodes.text: For a latest, Session or task document, a base makes every older record useless, and all three storage backends delete them. Retiring such a document deletes all its records. A rewindable document keeps everything, because old values must stay readable spec §3.5.
nodes.zh: 对 `latest` 的 session 或 task 文档来说，一个基线让所有更早的记录失去用处，三种存储后端都会把它们删掉。退役这样一个文档会删掉它的全部记录。可回溯的文档什么都保留，因为旧值必须始终可读 `spec §3.5`。

nodes.text: That is what makes snapshotAsOf() work. On app.todos, the value as of entry 6 (written at seq 3) is base 2 plus delta 3: {"items":["write docs","fix build"]}. On app.draft the same call fails with Document 5 does not retain historical content.
nodes.zh: 这就是 `snapshotAsOf()` 能工作的原因。在 `app.todos` 上，条目 6 时的值（写于 seq 3）是基线 2 加增量 3：`{"items":["write docs","fix build"]}`。在 `app.draft` 上，同样那次调用会失败并抛出 `Document 5 does not retain historical content`。

nodes.text: Versions and migrations
nodes.zh: 版本与迁移

nodes.text: To change a document’s shape, raise version and add migrate(). Every record stores its version, and each read compares it with the token’s spec §3.6:
nodes.zh: 要改变文档的形状，就提高 `version` 并加上 `migrate()`。每条记录都存着自己的版本，每次读取都拿它与词元的版本比对 `spec §3.6`：

S T R U C T U R E

nodes.text: Migration happens when a document is used, never in bulk. A snapshot() through the new token returned the migrated value and wrote nothing. The first write through it stored a version-2 base (seq 8). From then on, the old version-1 token fails with has newer version 2 than 1, so code rolled back past that write can no longer open the document. The old version-1 records stay, and snapshotAsOf() through the new token migrates them on the fly.
nodes.zh: 迁移发生在文档被使用时，绝不会批量进行。通过新词元做的一次 `snapshot()` 返回了迁移后的值，没有写入任何东西。通过它的第一次写入存下了一个 version 2 的基线（seq 8）。从那以后，旧的 version 1 词元会失败并抛出 `has newer version 2 than 1`，因此回滚到那次写入之前的代码再也无法打开这个文档。旧的 version 1 记录保留下来，通过新词元调用 `snapshotAsOf()` 会即时迁移它们。

nodes.text: Forks copy documents
nodes.zh: 分叉会复制文档

nodes.text: Forking conversation 2 at entry 7 copied each of its documents by that document’s own policy:
nodes.zh: 在条目 7 处分叉 conversation 2，会按每个文档自己的策略复制它们：

lines: A fork copies each conversation document by its own policy, into a new incarnation with one base. IDs, sequences and values from research/capture/extra-p4/documents.txt; the policies are those of spec §3.7.

nodes.text: Each copy is a new, independent document with a new ID and one base spec §3.7. Storage makes the copy itself; a remote backend does it server-side. The copy keeps the stored version; the child migrates on its own first use. One restriction follows from copying committed values: a commit that forks may not also change one of the parent’s current documents. It fails with Cannot fork conversation 2 while changing its current-policy documents. Commit the parent’s change first src/session/transaction.ts.
nodes.zh: 每个副本都是一份全新的独立文档，有新 ID 和一个基线 `spec §3.7`。副本由存储自己造；远程后端则在服务端完成。副本保留存储时的版本；子副本在第一次使用时自行迁移。复制已提交的值带来一条限制：分叉的那次提交不得同时改动父级中 current-policy 的文档。它会失败并抛出 `Cannot fork conversation 2 while changing its current-policy documents`。先把父级的改动提交掉 `src/session/transaction.ts`。

nodes.text: Give every long-lived document a checkpointWhen. A delta count, like the spec’s info.deltasSinceBase >= 31, is the simplest rule. Change a document’s shape with a new version and migrate(). Never rename its kind: the new name finds nothing and creates an empty document beside the old one. A rename needs an explicit copy and retirement spec §12. Choose rewindable only when you need old values. It never frees space.
nodes.zh: 给每个长命的文档都配一个 `checkpointWhen`。增量计数是最简单的规则，比如 spec 里的 `info.deltasSinceBase >= 31`。改变文档形状要用新版本加 `migrate()`。绝不要改它的 kind：新名字找不到任何东西，只会在旧文档旁边创建一个空文档。改名需要显式复制并退役 `spec §12`。只在需要旧值时才选 `rewindable`。它永远不会释放空间。

nodes.text: 4 . 4 The built-in documents
nodes.zh: 4.4 内置文档

nodes.text: Five conversation documents hold what the Harness needs between commits: what the agent is, who the provider sees, what is running, what is waiting,
nodes.zh: 五个 conversation 文档保存着 `Harness` 在两次提交之间需要的东西：智能体是什么、供应商看到的是谁、什么在运行、什么在等待，

nodes.text: and what it cost.
nodes.zh: 以及它花了多少。

nodes.text: The Harness stores its own state the same way you store yours: in documents. A UI reads them to show a spinner, a queue or a bill. After this section you can read the docs block of any conversation view and say what writes each part. The five documents are defined with the same defineDoc() as yours, and their tokens are exported: AgentDoc, ProviderDoc, LiveDoc, InboxDoc and UsageDoc src/index.ts. All five belong to one conversation, are created with it, and appear in its view under docs[kind] (the conversation view (p. 129)). Your own documents are not mounted there; watch them with watchDoc().
nodes.zh: `Harness` 存储自身状态的方式和你存储自己的一样：放在文档里。UI 读它们来显示加载指示、队列或账单。读完本节你就能读出任意 conversation 视图的 `docs` 块，并说清每一部分由什么写入。这五个文档和你的一样用 `defineDoc()` 定义，它们的词元已导出：`AgentDoc`、`ProviderDoc`、`LiveDoc`、`InboxDoc` 和 `UsageDoc` `src/index.ts`。五个都属于同一个 conversation，随它一起创建，并在它的视图里以 `docs[kind]` 出现（conversation 视图（p. 129））。你自己的文档不会挂在那里；用 `watchDoc()` 观察它们。

nodes.text: pi.agent — what was chosen for this conversation: model, thinking level, extensions, tools, instructions and working directory. It stores names, never code src/harness/types.ts (AgentState). configure() changes it, and a tool result can add or remove tools. How names become a running agent is in the per-conversation agent (p. 106).
nodes.zh: `pi.agent` —— 为这个 conversation 选定的内容：模型、思考级别、扩展、工具、指令和工作目录。它存的是名称，从不存代码 `src/harness/types.ts`（`AgentState`）。`configure()` 修改它，工具结果也可以增删工具。名称如何变成一个运行中的智能体，见「每个 conversation 的智能体」（p. 106）。

nodes.text: pi.provider — { sessionId }, the ID the provider sees, used for prompt-cache affinity. Reset, compaction, model changes and reopen keep it spec §2.2. A conversation stored before 1.0.2 gets one on its first request src/harness/provider.ts; CHANGELOG.md. pi.live — run control and progress. run is present exactly while the conversation is busy; generation, tools and compactions show what is in flight src/harness/live.ts. pi.inbox — { items }, the inputs and writes waiting for the next boundary, in order src/harness/inbox.ts. pi.usage — this conversation’s spend, keyed by provider/modelId and by tool name. Failed and aborted attempts count too spec §8.6. Harness.usage() adds up every conversation. pi.live shows how a good checkpoint rule keeps storage small. It writes a base whenever nothing is running, so its edits never pile up past one tool round:
nodes.zh: `pi.provider` —— `{ sessionId }`，供应商看到的 ID，用于提示词缓存亲和。重置、压缩、模型更换和重新打开都会保留它 `spec §2.2`。在 1.0.2 之前存储的 conversation 会在第一次请求时拿到一个 `src/harness/provider.ts`；`CHANGELOG.md`。 `pi.live` —— 运行控制与进度。`run` 恰好在 conversation 忙碌期间存在；generation、工具和压缩显示正在执行中的内容 `src/harness/live.ts`。 `pi.inbox` —— `{ items }`，等待下一个边界的输入与写入，按顺序排列 `src/harness/inbox.ts`。 `pi.usage` —— 这个 conversation 的开销，按 provider/modelId 和工具名为键。失败和中止的尝试也计入 `spec §8.6`。`Harness.usage()` 把所有 conversation 加起来。 `pi.live` 展示了一条好的检查点规则如何让存储保持小巧：只要没有东西在运行，它就写一个基线，因此它的编辑不会堆积超过一轮工具调用：
